prompts.monster: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original monster source for a 1993 first-person dungeon crawler, to be reduced to 64, 40 and 24 pixels tall. Subject: the Bell Porter, a squat broad-shouldered abbey creature with an enormous hollow bronze bell as its head, no face, a dark void inside the bell, two short heavy feet, ragged deep teal robe, and two thick stone-grey arms, one arm raised in a very clear attack wind-up. A single strong full-body silhouette, front three-quarter view looking toward camera, both feet visible, centered and occupying most of the square with generous transparent margins. Style: hand-painted early-1990s VGA fantasy game illustration, broad hard-edged shade groups, warm ochre bronze against cool desaturated teal, inky navy shadows, a few parchment highlights, very little tiny detail. No weapons or separate props, no text, no UI, no floor, no contact shadow, no environmental background. Actual transparent background. This is an original creature, no existing game characters. The bell mouth and large arm must remain legible at 24 pixels tall.
prompts.wall: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original stone wall texture source for a 1993 first-person dungeon crawler, reduced offline to 64 by 64 pixels. A flat straight-on close view of old abbey ashlar masonry. Large uneven hand-cut limestone blocks, dark recessed mortar, 3 or 4 staggered courses across the square, a few broad chips and restrained teal damp stains. Hand-painted early-1990s VGA game art, broad quiet shapes and discrete shade groups, inky navy and blue-grey shadows, muted warm grey stones with sparse ochre highlight, no fine photographic noise. Texture fills the entire square edge to edge, no perspective, no arch, no opening, no vignette, no text, no decoration, no objects, no characters. Soft neutral frontal lighting. Designed for repeat use but actual seamlessness will be checked offline.
prompts.hero: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original 32 by 32 pixel hero portrait source for a 1993 first-person dungeon crawler, painted larger then reduced offline. One Finder: a weathered middle-aged woman with short dark hair, deep brown skin, alert amber-brown eyes and a worn teal travelling hood. A kind but wry practical face rather than a glamour portrait. Tight head-and-shoulders crop filling the square, face large and clearly readable, three-quarter face toward viewer. Hand-painted early-1990s VGA fantasy game portrait, bold simplified facial planes, distinct broad shading clusters, muted warm ochres for skin, deep desaturated teal hood, navy background, parchment highlights. Restrained palette and no tiny jewellery or fine hair strands. No border, no text, no UI. Opaque dark navy background. Original character.
